info.title: UCRP — Unified Retail Customer Platform for Shopping Centers
info.description:
REST API specification for the shopping center unified guest profile platform (case #2). Source of truth for paths and methods — `endpoint-registry.md` (90 endpoints); for data structure — `05-er-data-model.md` (E-1…E-21).

Conventions:
* Base prefix — `/api/v1`; `/healthz` is outside the prefix.
* Format — JSON, UTF-8; time in UTC (RFC 3339); money — integer minor units (`amountMinor`, 35000 = 350.00 RUB).
* JSON field names — `camelCase`; query parameter names keep the registry notation (`snake_case`).
* Authentication — `Authorization: Bearer <JWT access>` (TTL 15 min), refresh — httpOnly cookie. Role and `tenantId` come from the token claims.
* Roles: `R-1` Management company marketer, `R-2` Manager, `R-3` Tenant, `R-4` Analyst, `R-6` System (does not use REST). `R-5` Guest has no access.
* R-3 isolation: `tenantId` comes only from the claims; a mismatch with the path/request → 403 `forbidden_tenant`; the repository always applies `WHERE tenant_id = :claimTenant`.
* Unified error format: `{"error":{"code","message","details":[{"field","reason"}],"request_id"}}`.
* Check order: 401 (authentication) → 403 (role) → 400 (validation) → 403 (foreign tenant) → 404 → 409.
* Timeout budget: request 30 s, segment preview 10 s, synchronous export 25 s, connector external HTTP 30 s; exceeding → 504 `timeout`.
* The `x-roles` and `x-uc` extensions link an operation to the role registry and use cases.

get.summary: Guest distribution by tenant count and its trend
get.description: For active guests, counts the number of distinct `event.tenantId` values among events of types with `countsAsPresence`. Returns the 1 / 2 / 3+ distribution and the share of guests with two or more tenants. The period must not exceed 24 months and `from <= to`, otherwise 400.

Match rate (target ≥ 70%), disputed merge share (< 1%), segment → export time (median and p95, target ≤ 5 min), campaign conversion (≥ 3%), visit lift. All metrics are computed by queries over the ER tables; there are no dedicated metric tables.

R-3 receives only its own aggregates: the `tenantId` from the path is compared with the claim in the service, a mismatch → 403 `forbidden_tenant`; the repository uses only `...ForTenant` methods. The response contains no guest identifiers. Cells below k = 5 are suppressed (`suppressed = true`, value `null`). R-2, R-1, and R-4 may request any tenant.

For each source: last successful import date, share of rejected rows over 30 days, number of disputed profiles. A warning is raised when the rejected share exceeds 10% or the data is older than 7 days.
Chart of rejected rows per import and links to specific imports. A source without imports is a valid state with empty series, not an error.
Append-only log. Filters by entity, actor, and period. Each record contains `requestId` for end-to-end tracing.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description: Verifies the password hash and account activity. The same 401 for a wrong email and a wrong password does not reveal whether the user exists. The access token lives 15 minutes and carries the `sub`, `role`, and `tenantId` claims (for R-3). The refresh token is delivered in an httpOnly cookie.

Set-Cookie.description: refresh token, httpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict, Path=/api/v1/auth

post.summary: Refresh the access token using the refresh cookie
post.description: Reads the refresh token from the httpOnly cookie. An expired or revoked token → 401 and the client returns to the sign-in screen. The SPA performs the refresh single-flight.
Revokes the current refresh token and clears the cookie. The access token remains valid until its TTL expires.

get.summary: Current user profile, role, and tenantId
get.description: Used by the SPA to build the role-based menu. For R-3 it returns `tenantId` from the claims — the only source of the tenant for subsequent checks.

post.description: Sets the target tenant, segment, and attribution window (14 days by default).

patch.description: Changing the segment or target tenant after the first export is not allowed — 409 `campaign_locked`.

delete.description: Deletion is not allowed when the campaign has exports — 409 `campaign_has_exports`.

get.summary: Visit conversion and lift versus the control group
get.description: Conversion is the share of recipients (`contact_log`) with at least one `countsAsPresence` event at the campaign target tenant within `(contactedAt, contactedAt + attributionDays]`. Lift is the difference between recipient and control group conversion; significance is a two-sample test of proportions. The control group baseline is measured from `export.createdAt`, because control members are not written to `contact_log`.
`channel = null` — a general rule for all channels. When several rules apply, the strictest one wins.

post.description: `maxContacts >= 1`, `periodDays >= 1`, otherwise 400.
Returns four numbers: total in segment, with a channel contact, blocked by limit, in control group. Writes nothing to the database. The contact filter runs before the limit and the control group.

post.summary: Create a segment export to a channel
post.description: The `Idempotency-Key` header is required: repeating the same key returns the same export and creates no new `contact_log` rows. Order: key check → segment version `ready` (otherwise 409 `segment_not_ready`) → channel contact filter (`sms`/`push` — phone, `email` — email) → strictest limit rule → control group by `controlSeed` → transactional write with a repeated limit check. If no recipients remain — 409 `contact_limit_exceeded` with a breakdown of reasons. Up to 20,000 members are built synchronously (201); larger exports use the `export.build` job (202).

get.description: Invariant: `exportedCount + controlCount + noContactCount + blockedByLimitCount = totalInSegment`.

get.summary: Recipients and control group (API export for the provider)
get.description: Returns only guests with a contact for the required channel. The provider calls this with the personal token of R-1. The `is_control` parameter separates recipients from the control group.
The control group is not included in the file. If the export is not ready — 409 `export_not_ready`.

Searches by phone, email, card, or name. The input is normalized with the same rules as during import, so `+7 900 123-45-67` and `89001234567` find the same guest. Merged profiles (`status=merged`) are excluded from results.

Returns identifiers, the number of visited tenants (`tenantCount`), segments, and feed aggregates. If the guest was absorbed by a merge, the 200 response contains `mergedIntoId` and the UI redirects to the current profile.

delete.description: Sets `status=deleted` and `deletedAt`. There is no hard delete: events and identifiers are preserved for reversibility and audit.

get.description: Sorted by `occurredAt` descending. Each record contains type, tenant, project, date, and amount.
`contact_log` records across all exports. The control group is not logged as contacts.

Reading does not recompute recommendations. Invariants: a listed tenant is not among the guest visited tenants; direct competitors (`tenant_category_relation.relationType = competitor`) are excluded. An empty list is a valid state, not an error.

post.description: Synchronous `Recommender.Refresh` call with a 10 s deadline; on timeout — 504 `timeout`. The recommendation set is replaced in a single transaction, so reads never see a partial set.

get.summary: Segment aggregate: top tenants to invite
get.description: Aggregates recommendations of segment members and returns the tenants most often suggested to the segment, with the number of candidate guests.
Sorted by `createdAt` ascending. R-1 has read-only access; resolution operations are available to R-4.

get.summary: Two profiles side by side with the match reason

post.description: Executed in a single transaction: events and identifiers move to the winner while `originGuestId` is preserved, the loser gets `status=merged` and `mergedIntoId`, and `merge_candidate.resolution=confirmed` plus an audit record are written. On success, segment and recommendation recomputes are enqueued for both guests.
Sets `resolution=rejected` and creates a merge block (`unmerge_block`), so automatic merging will not repeat this pair.

Also works for automatic merges (`auto_merged`). Rows with `originGuestId = loser` are returned to the loser, the profile becomes `active` again, `resolution=reverted`, and an `unmerge_block` plus an audit record are created — all in one transaction. If the resolution is neither `confirmed` nor `auto_merged` — 409.
Merges guest `{id}` into `targetGuestId`. Merging with itself → 400; a blocked pair → 409 `merge_blocked` (remove the block via `DELETE /unmerge-blocks/{id}`).

delete.description: Once removed, the pair can be merged automatically again when a shared reliable key appears.

post.description:
Accepts a multipart request, streams the sha256, and creates an `ImportBatch` with status `queued`, enqueuing the `import.process` job (`dedupKey = import:{batchId}`) in the same transaction as the audit record. The 202 response returns immediately and the UI polls `GET /imports/{id}` every 2 s.

If the same file (sha256) was already uploaded for this source, a 200 is returned with the existing `batchId` and `duplicate=true`, and no new events are created.

Limits: up to 100,000 rows; an unsupported format or missing required columns per the mapping → 422 without creating events.

200.description: Duplicate file: the existing import is returned

get.description: Invariant: `acceptedRows + rejectedRows + duplicateRows = totalRows`. Status `completed_with_errors` is set when `rejectedRows > 0`.
Reason codes: `bad_date`, `no_external_id`, `bad_amount`, `unknown_event_type`, `bad_phone`. With `format=csv` a downloadable file is returned.

post.summary: Manually trigger a pull from an API source
post.description: Enqueues a `connector.pull` job with `dedupKey = pull:{sourceId}:{window}`. If a sync for the same window is already running, returns 409 `sync_in_progress`.

get.description: `tenantId = null` means a shared management company source (Wi-Fi, parking).

post.description: `fieldMapping` maps file/API response columns to platform fields (`externalId`, `occurredAt`, `amountMinor`, `phone`, `email`, `card`, `eventType`).

delete.description: If the source has imports, it is deactivated (`isActive=false`) and history is preserved. Response 204.

get.description: Base types: `crm`, `pos`, `api`, `csv_excel`. `connectorKey` points to the `SourceConnector` implementation in code.

post.description: A connector with the given `connectorKey` must exist in code, otherwise 400 `connector_not_registered`.

get.description: `countsAsPresence=true` means the event participates in visit counting and cross-tenant penetration.

patch.summary: Update or deactivate an event type

delete.description: Deletion is not allowed when events use the type — 409 `event_type_in_use`; deactivate it instead.

post.description: The `(tenantId, code)` pair is unique — 409 `duplicate_project_code`.

delete.description: Deletion is not allowed when the project has events — 409 `project_has_events`.
Deletion is not allowed when the category is used by tenants or relations — 409 `category_in_use`.

get.description: Returns the category relations in both directions. Used by recommendation scoring: `adjacent` boosts the score, `competitor` excludes the candidate.

put.description: Full set replacement (idempotent). Self-relations and duplicate pairs are rejected — 400.

get.description: R-3 sees only its own record: the `tenant_id = :claimTenant` filter is applied in the repository and any value from the request is ignored.
R-3 is allowed only its own record; a foreign `id` → 403 `forbidden_tenant`.

patch.description: R-1 may change only the `priority` field (recommendation scoring priority); changing any other field → 403 `forbidden_field`.

delete.description: Deletion is not allowed when the tenant has events — 409 `tenant_has_events`.

get.description: "Sleeping neighbor", "Single store", "Churn risk", "Newcomer", "High value". A template is the same segment with `isTemplate=true` and a ready-made rule.

get.summary: List segments with size and computedAt

post.description: Creates the segment and rule version 1 with status `pending`, writes an audit record, and enqueues `segment.recompute` (`dedupKey = segment:{id}:{versionNo}`). The 201 response returns immediately; membership is computed by the worker.

post.summary: Size and 20 examples for an unsaved rule
post.description: Does not write to the database. The result is cached by rule hash (TTL 60 s). Deadline 10 s; on timeout — 504 `timeout` suggesting a narrower period. A tenant listed in both `was` and `wasNot` → 400 with the field indicated.

get.description: Contains the current version, the rule in business language (`ruleText`), size, recompute status, and `computedAt`. While the status is `pending` or `computing`, exporting from the segment returns 409.

put.description: Each edit creates an immutable `segment_version` with `versionNo + 1`; previous versions remain available, and exports reference a specific version and stay reproducible.

delete.description: If an active campaign references the segment — 409 `segment_in_active_campaign`.

get.description: Defaults to the current version; the `version` parameter shows the membership of a historical version.

post.description: Enqueues `segment.recompute` with `dedupKey = segment:{id}:{versionNo}`. If this version is already being recomputed — 409 `recompute_in_progress`.

get.description: Outside the `/api/v1` prefix, no authentication. Checks database and queue availability.

post.description: For the `tenant` role (R-3) `tenantId` is required; a database CHECK constraint ties the role to the tenant. The password is set by the administrator and delivered outside the API (or via a reset link).

patch.description: Partial update. Changing the role to `tenant` requires `tenantId`. A password reset invalidates the user refresh tokens.

delete.description: No hard delete: `isActive=false` and refresh tokens are revoked. The last active R-2 cannot be deactivated — 409.

bearerAuth.description: Access token (TTL 15 min). Claims: sub (userId), role (marketer | manager | tenant | analyst | system), tenantId (required for the tenant role), exp.

cookieAuth.name: refresh_token
cookieAuth.description: Refresh token in an httpOnly cookie, issued by POST /auth/login, used only by POST /auth/refresh.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Export idempotency key. Unique per author (UNIQUE(created_by, idempotency_key)). Repeating the same key returns the existing export.

Unauthorized.description: Token missing, expired, or signature invalid (401)

Forbidden.description: Role not allowed for this operation, or foreign tenant (403)

Conflict.description: State conflict: contact limit, duplicate, busy resource, already resolved merge (409)

PayloadTooLarge.description: File too large or more than 100,000 rows (413)

UnprocessableEntity.description: Semantically invalid file: format, encoding, missing required columns (422)

penetrationRate.description: Share of guests with 2 or more tenants
Share of active guests with 2 or more tenants

matchRate.description: Events with guestId ÷ all accepted events in the period (target ≥ 0.70)

segmentToExportMedianSeconds.description: Median time from segment version creation to the first export (target ≤ 300 s)

conversionRate.description: Share of recipients with a visit to the target tenant within the attribution window (target ≥ 0.03)

incrementalRate.description: Recipient conversion minus control group conversion (target > 0)

newGuests.description: null if the value is below the k = 5 threshold

newGuestsViaComplex.description: New guests acquired through the complex (A-13). null when the value is < k

suppressed.description: true — some cells are suppressed by the k = 5 threshold

rejectedShare30d.description: Share of rejected rows over 30 days

pendingMergeCandidates.description: Disputed profiles linked to the source

actorRole.description: Role snapshot at the time of the action

details.description: Snapshot of the operation significant parameters

conversions.description: Recipients with a visit within the attribution window

incrementalRate.description: Conversion difference: recipients minus control group

request_id.description: Request identifier for tracing and support

field.description: Path to the request body field or the query parameter name

UserRole.description: User role. `marketer` = R-1, `manager` = R-2, `tenant` = R-3, `analyst` = R-4, `system` = R-6.

ExportChannel.description: Communication channel. `sms` and `push` require a phone, `email` requires an email.

withContact.description: With a contact for the channel

controlSeed.description: Seed for deterministic control group selection

downloadUrl.description: Relative CSV path when the export is ready

channel.description: null — rule applies to all channels

IdentifierType.description: Identifier type. `phone` and `email` are reliable merge keys.

valueNormalized.description: Normalized value: phone in E.164 without `+`, email lowercased

originGuestId.description: Original key owner before the merge — the basis for reversibility

isReliable.description: Key is eligible for automatic merge

mergedIntoId.description: Current profile if the guest was absorbed by a merge

tenantCount.description: Number of distinct tenants in the guest events

totalAmountMinor.description: Guest total revenue in minor units

guestId.description: null — the event is not yet linked to a guest (match rate denominator)

explanation.description: Snapshot of the explanation text at computation time
explanation.example: Similar guests visit Cinema; Sports and Entertainment are adjacent categories; floor 2 → floor 3

guestCount.description: How many segment guests were recommended this tenant

guestAId.description: Smaller identifier of the pair (canonical order)

targetGuestId.description: Winning profile that the guest from the path is merged into

duplicate.description: true — a file with this sha256 was already uploaded for this source

xM.description: X coordinate on the floor plan, meters

yM.description: Y coordinate on the floor plan, meters

CategoryRelationType.description: `adjacent` — adjacent category (boosts the score), `competitor` — direct competitor (excludes the candidate)

weightPct.description: Relation weight in percent for scoring

relations.description: Complete new set of category relations

hasAmount.description: The event carries a monetary amount

countsAsPresence.description: The event counts as a visit and participates in cross-tenant penetration

configSchema.description: JSON schema for the configuration of this source type

FieldMapping.description: Mapping of source fields to platform fields

tenantId.description: null — shared management company source (Wi-Fi, parking)

SegmentRule.description: Segment rule (JSON DSL). Compiled into parameterized SQL, so arbitrary queries are impossible.

was.description: Guest had an event at any of these tenants

wasNot.description: Guest had no events at any of these tenants

categoriesWas.description: Guest visited a tenant in the category

requireContact.description: Require a contact of the given type

templateCode.description: When set, template parameters are applied to the rule

cached.description: Result served from cache by rule hash

tenantId.description: User tenant. Required for the `tenant` role, otherwise null.

permissions.description: Permission list used to build the SPA menu

resetPassword.description: Trigger a password reset and revoke the user refresh tokens
